allow: PowerShell(git ls-files | Select-String '\\.codegraph' ; Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Directory -Force -Filter .codegraph | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName; Get-Content \(Join-Path $_.FullName 'config.json'\) -TotalCount 40 })

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Force -Recurse -Depth 1 -Filter .codegraph -Directory | ForEach-Object { "== $\($_.FullName\)"; Get-ChildItem -Force $_.FullName | Select-Object Name,Length,LastWriteTime | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String })
